anime.title: Jujutsu Kaisen

anime.title: Assassination Classroom

anime.title: Attack on Titan

anime.title: Naruto

anime.title: One-Punch Man

anime.title: Death Note

anime.title: Chainsaw Man

anime.title: My Hero Academia

anime.title: Shangri-La Frontier

anime.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime

anime.title: Re:Zero – Starting Life in Another World

anime.title: Hunter x Hunter
anime.synopsis: A boy sets off to become a Hunter like his absent father, facing brutal exams and dangerous enemies in a world filled with rare beasts and hidden powers.

anime.title: Fairy Tail
anime.synopsis: A celestial wizard joins the rowdy Fairy Tail mage guild and goes on wild adventures alongside her dragon-slaying partner Natsu.

anime.title: Tower of God

anime.title: Fire Force

anime.title: Ranking of Kings
anime.synopsis: A deaf, powerless prince dismissed as the world's weakest ruler sets out to prove himself while uncovering the dark truths behind his kingdom.

anime.title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles

anime.title: Wind Breaker

anime.title: Horimiya

anime.title: Code Geass

anime.title: Darling in the FranXX

anime.title: Tokyo Revengers

anime.title: Radiant

anime.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride
anime.synopsis: A girl who can see spirits is sold at auction and purchased by a powerful non-human mage who declares she will be his apprentice — and his bride.

anime.title: Log Horizon

anime.title: Rurouni Kenshin

anime.title: Black Butler

anime.title: The Apothecary Diaries

anime.title: Gachiakuta

anime.title: Naruto Shippuden

anime.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest

anime.title: Spy x Family: Code White
anime.synopsis: The Forger family heads on a mission abroad that quickly escalates into a world-threatening crisis only the fake family can stop — together.

anime.title: You and I Are Polar Opposites
anime.synopsis:
Miyu Suzuki is a high school girl whose cheerful outlook on life is tempered by her need to fit in. Coincidentally, beside her in the classroom sits Yuusuke Tani, a boy unconcerned with others' expectations. Their exchanges rarely extend beyond brief discourse, yet the polarity of their demeanors unexpectedly draws them to one another.

As their mutual interest grows, the newfound feelings are no longer easy to ignore. Eventually, Suzuki voices what is inside her heart, forcing both of them to confront the unspoken affection between them. With each passing moment, their relationship evolves, and they gradually come to better understand themselves and the person who is their polar opposite.
